title: D-091 TW2: dual-review conductor behind the loop's single reviewer seam (Codex + Claude reviews, combiner, slots), default off
objective: Add dual_review.py: a conductor with the same .review() interface the loop already calls that, when enabled, reserves a slot (TW1), runs the Codex and Claude reviewers on the same frozen packet independently, combines them with review_combiner (verdict = the worse of the two; disputes advisory), resolves each model against the controller allowlists (M0-T169 G5 N1), treats the combined verdict as authoritative and surfaces disputed findings for the human gate (N3), and counts a raised reviewer exception as FAIL (M0-T168 N1). Change loop.py only by the minimal injection (one parameter and one swapped call); default off keeps the single-Codex-reviewer path byte-identical. The loop never records gates (ADR-005).
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: move the loop to the cloud server with Codex and Claude reviews and a combining model.
inputs: review notes: M0-T168 N1, M0-T169 G5 N1/N3
forbidden_paths: loop.py beyond the minimal injection (it is above the modularity ceiling)
codex_reviewer.py, claude_reviewer.py, review_combiner.py, review_slots.py (call them, do not edit)
choosing a combining model (D-091-R008 is the owner's choice)
starting or commissioning a live loop, or any owner-typed step (runbook section 12)
codex login or handling any owner credential
weakening any fail-closed check, gate, reviewer-independence rule or the orchestrator's sole authority (ADR-005)
Windows behavior changes: existing Windows paths and tests must keep passing unchanged
acceptance_scenarios: default off: the loop's behavior and outputs are byte-identical to today (single Codex reviewer)
enabled: both reviewers run on the same frozen packet, neither sees the other, and the loop receives the combined verdict (the worse of the two)
a reviewer that raises, times out or returns malformed output makes the combined verdict FAIL/UNVERIFIED, never PASS
a model not in its allowlist is refused before any process; an unset combining model refuses (fail closed)
slots: if no review slot is available the conductor waits or refuses per TW1 and never runs a third concurrent review
disputed findings are surfaced in the loop's report for the human gate; the loop never records a gate
risks: recertification: every tools/agent_supervisor/** edit invalidates the frozen certification; one recertification task runs after all D-091 code tasks
